sources.name: PVPlant (FreeCAD workbench)
sources.licence_observation: file headers: GNU LGPL version 2 or later, referring to a LICENCE text file that does not exist at this commit; no repository-level licence (same observation as Module 01)
sources.maturity_observation: last commit 2023; FreeCAD/GUI-bound code with commented-out experiments and TODOs; no test suite found
terrain_features_observed: Terrain mesh from points: scipy Delaunay over all points inside a cutting boundary, then faces filtered by maximum edge length and angle (PVPlantCreateTerrainMesh.py:136-146)
ESRI ASCII grid import and thin-plate RBF interpolation of CSV points onto a grid spanning the full bounding box (Utils/importDEM.py:29-66, 80-100)

Adjust-to-terrain: projects points along a table's centre line onto the mesh, sets each frame's z to the mean of two projected points and rotates the frame to follow the ground; optional linear-regression trend (PVPlantPlacement.py:771-874)
Earthworks cut/fill along tracker paths (PVPlantEarthWorks.py:137, 397) - grading, out of Module 02 scope
Slope colouring by face normal angle (PVPlantTerrainAnalisys.py:540-560)
Rack and foundation parameters with fixed defaults: NumberPole = 7, PoleLength = 3000 mm (PVPlantRack.py:885-898); foundation length 700 mm default (PVPlantFoundation.py:49)
defects_or_risks_observed_by_reading: Faces rejected by the edge/angle filter keep their zero-initialised vertices, so the mesh gains degenerate triangles at the origin instead of omitting them (PVPlantCreateTerrainMesh.py:141-146)

XLLCENTER is converted to a corner by subtracting half the grid width (cellsize * nx / 2) instead of half a cell (Utils/importDEM.py:58-59); GDAL places the same grid 2 m and 1 m differently in the probe

Elevations are multiplied by 1000 before cells are compared with the unscaled NODATA_VALUE, so a -9999 no-data cell becomes -9999000 and passes the != nodata test (PVPlantTerrain.py:311, 327, 356, 376, 436)
The RBF interpolation grid covers the whole bounding box, so it extrapolates outside the surveyed points (Utils/importDEM.py:97-100)
Ground is sampled only along each table's centre line; there is no clearance check over the full footprint, and points that miss the mesh are silently dropped (PVPlantPlacement.py:810-870)
Slope colouring uses angle - 90 for downward normals instead of 180 - angle (PVPlantTerrainAnalisys.py:553-554)
sources.use_in_module_02: Concepts only (centre-line following, pile parameters, earthworks scope boundary) and a list of failure modes the acceptance fixtures cover. No code is reused; licence status is unclear.

sources.name: pvlib-python
terrain_features_observed: tracking.calc_axis_tilt(slope_azimuth, slope_tilt, axis_azimuth): tan(axis_tilt) = cos(axis_azimuth - slope_azimuth) * tan(slope_tilt), cited to Anderson and Mikofski, NREL/TP-5K00-76626 (2020)
tracking.calc_cross_axis_tilt for slope-aware backtracking on one uniform planar slope
shading.ground_angle / masking_angle assume regular rows on uniform ground
sources.observation: Every terrain-related function assumes one uniform plane; there is no DEM or TIN handling.
sources.use_in_module_02: Independent oracle for uniform-slope geometry in the later reorientation milestone (e.g. axis tilt on a planar slope). Not a dependency of the vertical-lift milestone.

sources.name: agrivoltaic garden planner (Module 01 browser reference)
sources.observation: Only a single site elevation, taken from the weather record, is used for sun position (src/types/site.ts, src/types/weather.ts, src/ui/site-notice.ts). No terrain surface, DEM, TIN or terrain-following placement.
sources.use_in_module_02: None; therefore no REA question about terrain behaviour applies to this artifact.

sources.name: PROJ via pyproj
sources.licence: MIT (pyproj); PROJ under MIT/X (LICENSE_proj in the wheel)
sources.observation: Offline, without the EGM96 grid, WGS 84 ellipsoidal height -> EGM96 height silently uses a 'ballpark' no-op: 100 m in, 100 m out, accuracy -1, no warning or error; only_best=True, PROJ_ONLY_BEST_DEFAULT=YES and errcheck=True did not change that. TransformerGroup does warn that the best operation is unavailable.
sources.use_in_module_02: No vertical transformation in Module 02. Datum identity is checked and a mismatch is rejected. A later transformation feature would have to require the named grid and refuse ballpark operations explicitly.

sources.name: SciPy spatial / interpolate
sources.observation: Delaunay over points surrounding an unsurveyed 4 x 4 m gap triangulates the gap; LinearNDInterpolator returns a finite value (0.5) at its centre. Only points outside the convex hull give NaN.
sources.use_in_module_02: No implicit triangulation of scattered points in the first milestone; coverage is exactly the supplied triangles.

sources.name: GDAL via rasterio
sources.licence: rasterio BSD-3-Clause; GDAL MIT/X; the manylinux wheel also bundles GEOS (LGPL-2.1), OpenSSL libcrypto, curl, HDF5 and other libraries with their own terms
sources.observation: read(masked=True) masks the no-data cell; dataset.sample() without masked=True returns the raw -9999; GeoTIFF default AREA_OR_POINT=Area puts row 0/col 0 centre half a cell from the corner; ESRI ASCII XLLCENTER is converted correctly (lower-left corner 9, 19 for centre 10, 20 and cell 2 m).
sources.use_in_module_02: Candidate for the optional DEM adapter milestone; must use masked reads and explicit pixel registration. Optional dependency because of the bundled-library footprint.
